contexts.name: catalog
contexts.purpose: Which books exist and whether a copy is on the shelf.

terms.meaning: A title the library owns, with an author.
Whether a copy of a book is on the shelf right now.

contexts.name: circulation
contexts.purpose: Loans: a member borrows a book until a due date, then returns it.

terms.meaning: A member holds a book until its due date.
A person identified by an email address.

tasks.title: List books with availability
tasks.goal: Anyone can see every book and whether it is available.
criteria: Anyone can request the list of books and receives each book's title, author and availability.
A book with no copy on the shelf is listed as unavailable.
An empty catalog returns an empty list, not an error.

tasks.title: Search books by title
tasks.goal: Anyone can find books by part of the title.
criteria: Searching for a title fragment returns only books whose title contains it, ignoring case.
A search with no matches returns an empty list.
A search with blank text is rejected with a message that search text is required.

tasks.title: Open a loan for an available book
tasks.goal: A member can borrow an available book.
criteria: A member who borrows an available book gets a loan due 14 days after today.
Borrowing a book that is already out is refused, and the existing loan is unchanged.
Borrowing with an invalid email address is rejected before any loan is created.
After a successful loan the book is listed as unavailable.
out_of_scope: Limits on how many books a member can hold

tasks.title: Show a loan
tasks.goal: Anyone with a loan id can see the loan.
criteria: Asking for a loan by its id returns the member email, the book, the due date and whether it was returned.
Asking for an unknown loan id returns a not-found result.
out_of_scope: Listing all loans of a member

tasks.title: Return a borrowed book
tasks.goal: A member can return a book so it becomes available again.
criteria: Returning a borrowed book marks the loan returned and lists the book as available again.
Returning a book that was already returned is refused.
Returning with an unknown loan id returns a not-found result.
